text:
Quadruped in the dawn, tall in the day,
+        and with three feet wandering through the vain
+        realm of evening: so the eternal sphinx
+        saw her inconstant brother,
+
+
+        man; and with evening came a man
+        who deciphered, terrified, in the mirror
+        of the monstrous image, the reflection
+        of his decline and of his fate.
+
+
+        We are Oedipus, and in an eternal way
+        we are the long and triple beast, all
+        that we shall be and all that we have been.
+
+
+        To see the huge form of our being
+        would annihilate us; mercifully,
+        God grants us succession and oblivion.

translation.title: Oedipus and the Enigma
translation.editorial_note: The riddle becomes a metaphysical self-portrait: humanity is spared total vision of itself by temporal succession and forgetfulness.
